description: Piano Tiles — tap only the black tiles as they fall. Speed rises with every tile.

faqs.a: Tap a black tile before it reaches the bottom line. Tapping a white (empty) area or letting a black tile slip past ends the game.
Every 10 tiles the fall speed increases — it starts gentle and gets seriously fast.
Your best score is saved in your browser.

howto: Press “Start” — black tiles fall down 4 lanes.
Tap each black tile before it crosses the bottom.
Never tap white space, and never let a tile escape.
Score = tiles tapped. Chase your best!
title: Piano Tiles
